verdict.rationale: Xero's own docs say it generates consolidated financial statements and offers accurate financial reporting, plus instant answers on cash flow and profit trends, so statement generation is a first-party capability. The evidence never names the specific statements or the ability to pick any period on demand. missing for 10: explicit P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statement report documentation, arbitrary-period/on-demand date selection, independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: Generate consolidated financial statements in multiple currencies for a clear view of your financial position
Get instant answers about your cash flow, profit trends and financial health.
